leader.body: Thiébaut de Heu was a prominent patrician and civil leader in the Republic of Metz, elected as the city's Chief Alderman six times beginning in 1314. An outsider to the Messin patrician ruling class, Thiébaut's shrewd business and political decisions saw him rise from a representative of the commoners to a leading civil figure in his own right. By the end of his life he had amassed a considerable fortune in money and in land, constructed the magnificent Hotel de Heu, and transformed the Heu family from unknowns to one of the leading patrician families in Metz. History considers him to be the largest landowner and most successful businessman in the history of the Messin Republic.
leader.title: Thiébaut de Heu

civilization.body: The Messin Republic, or the Republic of Metz, was a republican government that emerged in the city of Metz and the surrounding countryside during the Middle Ages. During this period, the city was formally controlled by the eponymous Prince-Bishopric of Metz, but in 1234 the bishop was ousted from the city entirely, with the Messin citizens establishing a burgher republic in his stead. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries Metz emerged as one of the richest and most prosperous cities in the Holy Roman Empire, with its geographical position and reputation for security allowing it to flourish as a trading metropolis and major banking center. The Messin Republic also withstood several wars and sieges, with large alliances of local lords, powerful dukes, and even the King of France failing to capture the city over the centuries. As it was never conquered, the city of Metz earned the sobriquet of "the Inviolable" or "the Virgin City."

dawnOfMan.defeat:
After all this time, the Virgin City has been violated at your hands. Do you feel pride?
Defeat: How short-sighted of you. The people of Metz are much more valuable as trading partners than as subjects.
dawnOfMan.blessing:
"Greetings and good fortune to you, enterprising Thiébaut de Heu! You lead the Republic of Metz, a city which has thrown off the shackles of episcopal rule and transformed itself into a flourishing urban republic. In the Middle Ages, Metz's wealth and prosperity was matched by few cities across Europe. Its vast riches was overshadowed in reputation only by its impenetrability, with greedy local lords and even the King of France trying and failing to seize the city and stamp out its republic. Through shrewd business decisions and marriages, you rose from an unknown merchant into one of the richest and most prominent figures in the history of the republic, with the name 'de Heu' overshadowing many of the oldest oligarch families in the city. Truly, it was a time of wealth and grandeur!
Shrewd Thiébaut, the Messin Republic has lost much of its prestige, its name an oft-forgotten footnote in the annals of history. But the good citizens of Metz call upon you to lead them once more! Can you defend your urban republic and bring it into a new age of riches? Can you build a civilization that will stand the test of time?"
dawnOfMan.introduction: Well met! I am Thiébaut de Heu, Chief Alderman of Metz for the time being. Have you come to trade in the city? Or with me directly?
